rooted.description: An app whose pages in folders resolve relative URLs from the app's root.
rooted.$comment: An app whose pages in folders resolve their relative URLs from the app's root, the base every page had until each page was based at its own folder (apps.ts `asset`). Worn by the apps whose pages were written against the old base (app-grep found one, thecompanygardener's openai-math, T-124410); nothing else wears it.

publishing.description: The paths an app has published files at, so a request at one of them is answered its file before the app runs.
publishing.$comment: The paths an app has published files at (public-files.ts), so a request at one of them asks the directory for its file before the app runs, and a request at any other path goes on to the app without asking. The list is JSON in one text property, sorted, as `home.first` is. The directory keeps it in the transaction that writes the files themselves (./publishing-graph.ts); an app that never published wears none.

join.description: Who may join an app through its own rows, set by its space's owner.
join.$comment: The owner's policy and the original app's deployed manifest policy. Only the kernel writes either. A copy uses only its owner's policy.
